summary: Iteration 18 — verified reported 'Something went wrong' Super Admin login bug is RESOLVED end-to-end after backend+DB restore and admin reseed. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter18_login_bug_verification.py (7 tests, 7/7 passing) against the preview URL — POST /api/auth/login with finance@vortexglobal.info succeeds (200 + httpOnly access_token/refresh_token cookies + no secrets in body); wrong password and unknown email both return 401 with byte-identical JSON bodies (no account enumeration); GET /api/auth/me returns is_superadmin=true with permissions ['*']; GET /api/superadmin/overview returns 200. Frontend (Playwright on preview URL): (1) visiting /superadmin logged out redirects to /login; (2) wrong password stays on /login and shows a generic 'Invalid…' error — no 'Something went wrong' fallback; (3) unknown email stays on /login with same generic error — no 'Something went wrong'; (4) correct credentials navigate to /superadmin and the Super Admin Overview console renders (tiles: Customer Tenants, Platform Admins, Super Admins, Provider Accounts, Payments); (5) /api/auth/me from the authenticated browser returns is_superadmin=true, permissions ['*'], mfa_enabled=false; (6) revisiting /superadmin after login stays on /superadmin. No password/JWT/secret leaked in any auth response body. RBAC boundary intact.
critical_code_review_comments: Login flow now healthy: FE Login.jsx posts to /api/auth/login, backend returns 200 with httpOnly Secure SameSite=None cookies (access_token, refresh_token) and a user JSON free of secrets — matches security posture.
Both invalid-password and unknown-email paths return identical 401 JSON bodies (verified with r1.json() == r2.json()), so no timing-independent enumeration surface via response bodies.

Ops note: the reported 'Something went wrong' fallback in lib/api.js formatApiError is the correct UX when the network request has no response at all (backend/DB down). The RCA was environmental (sandbox pod restart), not a code bug. Consider adding a lightweight backend readiness probe surfaced on /login to give a clearer message the next time DB is unreachable, but this is optional polish, not a defect.

RBAC boundary on /superadmin route confirmed via redirect-to-/login when unauthenticated; still worth also asserting a non-superadmin platform admin gets bounced to /dashboard — not tested here because no such user is currently seeded in the fresh DB (only 1 Super Admin, 1 Platform Admin — the same super admin — per Overview tiles).

rca of the issue: Symptom: FE showed 'Something went wrong. Please try again.' on /login submit. RCA: sandbox pod restart brought backend down/DB reset; POST /api/auth/login therefore returned no response, tripping the network-error fallback in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js formatApiError. After services + Postgres were restored and the single Super Admin was reseeded from ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD (backend/.env), login returns 200 and the FE navigates to /superadmin. Mitigation applied by main agent: restart services + rerun seed; no code change needed. Recurrence mitigation: keep seed idempotent (already does password re-sync from ADMIN_PASSWORD on startup) and rely on supervisor to restart backend + postgresql on pod restart.
